profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science at UC Berkeley. Experience with the design and development of multi-tiered enterprise application for the health-care, banking, housing, and  retail industry.   Skilled as a front end and back end programmer in Web and Mobile Application development .

Technical and analytical skills expertise, open and interactive communication skills,  creative and innovative thinker, passionate worker.  Love learning new things, exploring fun and innovative ideas, and using my skills to help and contribute to the best of my abilities. 

Programming languages/ tools  : Swift, Java – Spring MVC, Python, C, HTML, Scheme, Java Script,  Hibernate, JSP, JSON, JQuery UI, Android SDK, MIPS. Databases and frameworks::  mySql, PostgreSql. Web Technologies : Struts2. Application Servers: Weblogic . Operating systems : Microsoft Windows 7/ Vista, UNIX (basics) .  IDE : Xcode, Eclipse, Python . Other tools : Camtasia, Jing, Microsoft Word, Prezi

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with the Federated Identity Team at Google & Auth0 to bring Google Sign In to third party sites. Lead engineer in development and testing of 3 Node JS open source libraries for Google I/0 :
        • 	node-jsonwebtoken - encoding, signing, encrypting, decoding, and verifying JWTs.
	• 	nodeOIDCMsg - creating and consuming specific types of JWTs (like id_tokens), including handling the set of keys, JWKS logic, including fetching them when needed.
	• 	nodeOIDCClient -  an OIDC client to handle discovery, registration, authentication and userinfo
	• 	nodeOIDCRP - high level API for an OIDC relying party (several clients for different OPs)
	• 	Prepared API design documentations for the libraries and presented to Google & Auth0

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built a behavioral biometrics and continuous authentication sdk which monitors keystroke patterns, touch motion pressure, swipe angles, etc using Angular JS and REST API. Working on implementing an API and proxy service using .NET Core in order to analyze the behavioral patterns of a user and perform machine learning analysis on the data.  Also working on redesigning a web application using Aurelia JS framework and Electron web application framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked with the Digital Re-imagination Studio to come up with industry changing ideas and innovations on the latest technology platforms. Gained technical expertise in IOS, TVOS and Watch OS development as well as other technologies, such as beacon technology, Microsoft Hololens, Microsoft LUIS, Microsoft Bot, Voice & Finger biometrics, Microsoft Speech Recognition, Core Bluetooth, Amazon Web Services, Amazon Echo, Alexa Skills Kit, Microsoft Azure Cloud, Nest and firebase framework, Notifications, Virtual Game Controller framework, Open Tok live streaming  and Unity, 3D panoramas, Spring MVC framework, Javascript, HTML, and CSS. Presented projects to multiple large clients. Used design thinking with the Re-imagination Studio team to research and re-innovate the current trends in modern banking, fleet management, healthcare and other industries.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
As Kaiser Permanente Intern, presented to the CIO on non-traditional competitors in healthcare. Researched about the telemedicine kiosks and health coaching. Also, presented about Identity and Access management and products, such as Oracle Identity Manager, Oracle Access Manager, Oracle Adaptive Access Manager, Enterprise Single Sign On, Oracle Privileged Access Manager to the Technology Risk Office.
 Worked on the KPIM-UI project for the TRO Department. Implemented the Manage My Reportees module which allows users to manage and provision their reportees. Developed the functionality for the search application module for KPIM Home page. Enhanced  the UI on the KPIM site,  designed Manage My Reportees, and writing test cases.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Developed an open dialogue module for Force.com’s developer console using Aura Framework, Java, Javascript, and CSS​. Key features included dynamically generated list­views,
sorting, paging and user interface. Created selenium tests​, attending meetings, and debugged.
 Front-end and back-end developer.

positions.title: Self Paced Center Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Tutoring students in Java, Python, and C in the Self Paced Center. Assisted students with projects. Led a final exam review session. Attended meetings regularly.

positions.title: CS10 Reader
positions.description: Graded various student projects, assignments and exam. Recorded scores and attended meeting regularly.

positions.title: CS10 Lab Assistant
positions.description: Working as a Lab Assistant for the CS10 (Beauty & Joy of Computing) course. Helped students understand key concepts, learn programming techniques, and fix bugs.

positions.title: Registration Chair
positions.description: Planned and conducted the annual leadership conference for around 500 college students with committee members. Created and managed website using Eventbrite.

volunteerExperiences.description: Created a virtual lab for the Immunology department at UC Berkeley to train senior students to perform a real lab.  Includes captions, mini quizzes, and interactive tools.
